name: Sarah M.
text: This is so helpful! I have a goldendoodle and had no idea hip dysplasia was so common in the breed. Already scheduled a vet appointment to discuss screening options.

name: James T.
text: Honestly, doodles are overpriced designer dogs with all these health problems. People should just get purebreds from reputable breeders instead of supporting backyard breeders.

name: Michelle K.
text: The ear infection section really resonated with me. My labradoodle had recurring ear issues until our groomer recommended weekly cleanings. Total game-changer!

name: David R.
text: Quick question: are older doodles more prone to joint issues? My 7-year-old cockapoo seems stiff after long walks lately.

name: Patricia L.
text: Great article but wish you mentioned the importance of pet insurance for doodles earlier. We learned this the hard way with a $3,000 emergency surgery bill.
